role: Pinned welcome video — the first thing a new visitor watches on TikTok, Reels and Shorts.
voice_note: Written to be spoken, not recited. Full sentences that run on, hedges left in, no chains of one-word fragments. Lines are also written so the words agree with the label burned into whatever artwork is on screen at that moment — the supply line lands on THE SUPPLY ONLY SHRINKS, the token line on TOKENOMIC, Vira's name on WHO IS VIRA?

lines.en: Every few months somebody predicts something about the future, and it keeps landing on the same year.
lines.vo_direction: Conversational, unhurried. Like the opening of a story, not a headline.

lines.en: AI timelines, disclosure files, geopolitics — different conversations sharing a date.
lines.vo_direction: Even pace through the list, no punching. It is an observation, not evidence.

lines.en: We're not going to tell you what happens, because nobody knows — we'd rather ask than pretend we have the answer.
lines.vo_direction: The most human line in the piece. Slight shrug on 'nobody knows'.

lines.en: That's what VIRUS2027 is built on.
lines.vo_direction: Plain statement. No emphasis on the name.

lines.en: And this is Vira, who notices the pattern in the noise before the rest of us.
lines.vo_direction: Warmer. A half-smile in the voice on 'before the rest of us'.

lines.en: Underneath the mystery the mechanics are deliberately boring, and the supply only shrinks.
lines.vo_direction: Drop the theatre entirely. This is the honest part and it should sound like it.

lines.en: It's a BNB Chain token running on Pulse prediction markets, so what you think about the future has somewhere to go.
Follow the signal, and remember the date.
lines.vo_direction: Quiet. An invitation, not a call to action.
